title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Berry Burst Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Berry Burst Ice by Vice, a captivating E-liquid that combines the vibrant flavors of mixed berries with an exhilarating blast of icy coolness. Get ready for a berry explosion that will leave your taste buds tingling with delight.
With each inhale, you’ll be greeted by the juicy medley of ripe berries. The combination of strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries creates a symphony of fruity goodness, delivering a sweet and tangy flavor profile that is sure to satisfy your cravings.
As the vapor unfolds, the icy coolness takes center stage, adding an invigorating sensation that elevates the overall experience. The menthol infusion provides a refreshing twist, enveloping your palate with a chilly burst of freshness that perfectly complements the berry blend.
Vice ensures a smooth and satisfying throat hit, allowing you to enjoy every puff to the fullest. Crafted with care using high-quality ingredients, Berry Burst Ice guarantees a consistent and premium vaping experience.
For those who crave the perfect fusion of mixed berries and a cool menthol kick, Berry Burst Ice by Vice is a must-have. Immerse yourself in the fruity symphony, let the icy coolness awaken your senses, and indulge in a truly satisfying vaping adventure. Get ready to experience the burst of berries like never before with Berry Burst Ice by Vice.
Flavour Notes:
Berry
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
